7182.title: Provider questions outlive their owning turn
7182.rootCauseOneLine: Turn completion leaves native provider questions pending, and answer resolution does not check whether their owning turn already ended.
7182.proposedFix: Close still-pending provider questions for the exact completed turn and atomically reject late answers, preserving plugin cards and in-flight acknowledged deliveries.
7182.caveats: Two clean trusted runs reproduce the shared server lifecycle defect only. OpenCode 2.2.5's 600-second timeout, resolved-without-model-delivery behavior, and rendered UI were not reproduced; current main's ACP capability is false. No safe full-incident fix was established.
